description: Source code for security token management, including key generation, MAC calculation, and JWT encoding/decoding within the JWTSecApi class.

classes.name: JWTSecApi

classes.description: Handles low-level security operations such as key management and MAC calculation.

methods.description: Decodes a JWT token and extracts the payload if the signature is valid.
